channel.name: Yaqeen Institute
channel.blurb: Evidence-based Islamic research and reminders — seerah, spiritual growth, the signs of the end times, and contemporary faith, mostly featuring Dr. Omar Suleiman. The faith-and-clarity complement to theMITmonk.

note: Concept summaries and value ratings are AI-generated digests to help you find the right talk fast — not transcripts or fatwas. For rulings, refer to the full lecture and qualified scholars. View counts are as of the last refresh.

videos.title: Khadijah (ra): His First Love, Our First Mother | The Firsts
videos.summary: The life of Khadijah (ra) — the first to believe, the Prophet's ﷺ greatest support, and a model of strength, loyalty and sacrifice. How her conviction anchored the earliest days of Islam.
videos.takeaway: Faith and unwavering support can change the course of history.

videos.title: Hamza Ibn Abdulmuttalib (ra): The Lion of Allah | The Firsts
videos.summary: The story of Hamza (ra), the Prophet's ﷺ uncle and protector — from his bold acceptance of Islam to his martyrdom at Uhud. A study in courage, loyalty and honour.
videos.takeaway: Courage means standing for truth when it costs you the most.

videos.title: Aisha Bint Abu Bakr (ra): The Early Years of Sacrifice | The Firsts
videos.summary: The early life of Aisha (ra) — one of the greatest scholars of Islam, who preserved and transmitted an enormous portion of the Prophet's ﷺ teachings. Sacrifice, intellect and devotion.
videos.takeaway: Knowledge is a trust to be preserved and passed on.

videos.title: Becoming the Best Version of Yourself | Lecture by Dr. Omar Suleiman
videos.summary: A faith-rooted take on self-improvement: aligning your growth with your purpose before Allah, refining character (akhlaq), and pursuing excellence (ihsan) rather than ego. The Islamic counterpart to secular self-development.
videos.takeaway: True self-improvement is becoming who Allah created you to be.

videos.title: Practicing Detachment: A Daily Guide to Freeing Your Heart for Allah | Khutbah
videos.summary: A practical guide to spiritual detachment (zuhd): loosening the grip of dunya on the heart so it is free for Allah. Responding to loss with contentment and keeping perspective amid distraction.
videos.takeaway: Hold the world in your hands, not in your heart.

videos.title: Are You a Mediocre Muslim? | Khutbah by Dr. Omar Suleiman
videos.summary: A wake-up call against spiritual complacency — settling for the bare minimum in faith and worship. How to move from going-through-the-motions to sincerity, consistency and excellence.
videos.takeaway: Don't settle for the minimum in what matters most.

videos.title: Defeat Your Ego Before It Defeats You | Midnight Majlis 2
videos.summary: Dr. Omar Suleiman and Sh. Yaser Birjas on mastering the ego (nafs): recognizing its tricks, choosing humility over pride, and the inner work of taming the self before it controls you.
videos.takeaway: The hardest battle is the one against your own ego.

videos.title: The End Times: Everything You Need to Know | Signs of the Hour Ep. 1
videos.summary: The opening episode of the Signs of the Hour series — an overview of Islamic eschatology: the minor and major signs, what's authentically established, and how to engage the topic with knowledge instead of fear.
videos.takeaway: Start here for a grounded map of the end times.

videos.title: The Major Sign That's Already Happened | Signs of the Hour Ep. 2
videos.summary: Episode 2 examines a major sign of the Hour that has, according to the narrations, already come to pass — and what it means for how near we are.
videos.takeaway: Some prophesied signs are already behind us.

videos.title: A Secret Investigation in Medina | Signs of the Hour Ep. 3
videos.summary: Episode 3 narrates a striking account tied to Medina and the unfolding signs — blending history and prophecy in the Signs of the Hour series.
videos.takeaway: Prophecy and history meet in the story of Medina.

videos.title: When 43 Prophets Were Killed | Signs of the Hour Ep. 5
videos.summary: Episode 5 recounts a harrowing chapter of trial and martyrdom tied to the signs of the Hour, and the lessons it carries about steadfastness in the face of persecution.
videos.takeaway: Trial has always been the test of true faith.

videos.title: When Only One Sahabi Was Left In The World | Signs of the Hour Ep. 6
videos.summary: Episode 6 explores the era and narrations surrounding the last of the companions and what their passing signified for the ummah and the approach of the Hour.
videos.takeaway: Generations pass, but the message endures.

videos.title: 7 Conquests He ﷺ Promised Before The Hour | Signs of the Hour Ep. 7
videos.summary: Episode 7 covers seven conquests the Prophet ﷺ foretold would precede the Hour — which have occurred, which remain, and how to read prophecy responsibly.
videos.takeaway: The Prophet's ﷺ foretold conquests are unfolding through history.

videos.title: 5 Ways to Have A Good Ending | Khutbah by Dr. Omar Suleiman
videos.summary: A khutbah on husn al-khatimah — a good ending. Five practical habits and states of heart that help one live, and ultimately die, upon faith and good deeds.
videos.takeaway: Live in the state you hope to die in.

videos.title: What If I've Lost Motivation? | Khutbah by Dr. Omar Suleiman
videos.summary: On spiritual burnout and lost motivation (futoor): why dips in faith and energy happen, and how to renew sincerity and consistency without despair. A faith-based answer to 'falling behind.'
videos.takeaway: Consistency, not intensity, carries you through the dips.

videos.title: Mariya al-Qibtiyya (ra): Mother of the Prophet's ﷺ Last Child | The Firsts
videos.summary: The story of Mariya al-Qibtiyya (ra), mother of the Prophet's ﷺ son Ibrahim — dignity, faith, and the human moments of grief and love in the Prophet's household.
videos.takeaway: Dignity and faith shine through life's hardest moments.

videos.title: Isra and Miraj: The Greatest Journey Through the Heavens | Al-Aqsa Series Ep. 6
videos.summary: The miraculous Night Journey and Ascension — from Mecca to Jerusalem to the heavens — and the centrality of Al-Aqsa and the gift of prayer that came from it.
videos.takeaway: Al-Aqsa and salah are woven into the heart of the faith.

videos.title: The Prophets, the Messiah, and the Promised Land | Al-Aqsa Series Ep. 3
videos.summary: How the prophets, the Messiah, and the idea of the 'promised land' fit within the Islamic narrative of Jerusalem and Al-Aqsa — untangling scripture, history and claims.
videos.takeaway: Jerusalem's story belongs to a long line of prophets.

videos.title: Zionism 1,000 Years In the Making | Al-Aqsa Series Ep. 9
videos.summary: A historical examination of the long roots behind modern claims to the land — context for understanding the present through a thousand years of history.
videos.takeaway: Today's headlines have centuries of history behind them.

videos.title: Two Rakats | 1st Place Short Film | Yaqeen Short Film Contest
videos.summary: The award-winning short film 'Two Rakats' — a moving, story-driven reminder about prayer and turning back to Allah, told through film rather than lecture.
videos.takeaway: Sometimes a story reaches the heart faster than a sermon.
